title: 3.2.0.1 Increased connection Problems with Omnipod Dash
symptom: Since updating to 3.2, the user experiences increased connection problems with Omnipod Dash, including errors where AAPS is unsure if SMB were delivered or profile changes didn't work, and a Pod-Fault error 095 ALARM_WIRE_TEST_OPEN_GROUND.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. The user later reports that after upgrading phone from Poco F3 on Lineage OS to Poco X6 Pro on stock OS, the problems went away, suggesting a phone/OS issue, but this is not confirmed.
fix: The user resolved the issue by upgrading their phone from Poco F3 on Lineage OS to Poco X6 Pro on stock OS, which made the problems go away. No specific configuration change was stated.
evidence_quote: I have now upgraded my phone (from Poco F3 on Lineage OS to Poxo X6 Pro on stock OS, and the problems went away. So I guess it was a phone/lineage problem?
